items.title: METAL ROOF RIDGE CAPPING REPAIR PERTH.
items.summary: Perth metal roof ridge capping project by Ellis Services Group, showing installation, completed cap runs, fixings and the adjoining eave detail.
items.content_text:
Our metal roof capping work brings the ridge, hip runs and roof-edge connections together. This project shows the installation detail and the completed grey capping across a corrugated roof.

Project story updated 2026-10-09

This roof brings several corrugated planes together beneath formed grey metal capping. The project photographs show the overall roof, a close installation view, the finished cap run and an eave connection. Together they explain the job more clearly than an isolated close-up: the repaired roof junction belongs to a continuous covering, with adjoining sheets and drainage at its edges.

The work-stage photograph shows our tradesperson securing the formed metal capping over the corrugated roof junction. The completed views show the cap continuing along the roof line, with its fixing points visible beside the sheet profile. Our work on these connections joins the cap to the surrounding covering and gives the junction a defined, consistent finish.

Ridge and hip capping cover the meeting point between roof planes. The formed metal, adjoining corrugations and fixing positions work together at that junction. A repair needs attention to the whole connection, including the direction of the cap run and the surrounding sheets. The close photographs make these workmanship details visible alongside the wider completed roof.

The finished project shows grey capping following the ridge and hip lines, with a separate close view of the roof edge beside the gutter. These images present both the central roof junction and its surrounding roofline. For owners needing similar work, our metal roof repairs service covers capping, affected sheets, fixings and flashing connections within a coordinated repair scope.

The wide image records the completed corrugated-metal roof surface and the finished ridge and hip lines.

The work-stage image shows a tradesperson securing the formed metal capping over the roof junction.

The close roofline view records the completed capping line and the screw-fixed connection along the corrugated sheets.

The final image records the relationship between the roof sheet, metal edge detail and adjoining gutter line.

items.title: TILE ROOF CHIMNEY FLASHING REPAIR PERTH.
items.summary: Tile roof chimney flashing work by Ellis Services Group, showing the formed apron, stepped side detail and adjoining valley on a Perth roof.
items.content_text:
We completed formed flashing work around this brick chimney and its adjoining tiled-roof valley. The project shows the chimney apron, side flashing and valley connection from both close and wider roof views.

Project story updated 2026-10-09

The brick chimney sits beside a valley between tiled roof planes. That layout brings two important water-management details together: the metal around the chimney base and the channel carrying water through the valley. The wide project photograph establishes their position in the roof, while the close views show how the formed metal meets the adjacent tiles.

The completed photographs show grey formed metal around the chimney, including the apron at its base and the stepped side detail against the brickwork. They also show the adjoining metal valley extending between the tiled slopes. Our work connects these details within the existing roof layout, with the photographs presenting the completed junction from several useful angles.

The apron is the formed metal projecting from the chimney base over the adjoining roof surface. The side flashing follows the chimney-to-roof junction along the sloping tiles. These are connected parts of the same detail, with the valley close by. The project explains why chimney work needs careful attention to both the masonry interface and the neighbouring roof covering.

The wider photographs show the completed flashing alongside the valley, tiles and nearby ridge lines. The close photographs show the apron and stepped metal detail. This combination makes the completed work easy to understand and demonstrates our focus on connected roof junctions. Our flashing repairs service handles chimney details, valleys and the adjoining tiled or metal roof connections.

The opening view records the chimney base, tiled roof slopes and the formed metal valley route.

The close view records the new grey metal detail continuing from the chimney apron into the tiled valley.

The wider view shows how the completed valley line sits between the adjoining tiled roof planes.

The final view records the stepped side flashing and apron detail at the brick chimney.

items.summary: Metal roof hip and ridge capping work by Ellis Services Group, with a formed multi-plane junction, completed cap runs and close fixing details.
items.content_text:
This metal roof project centres on the intersection between hip and ridge capping. Our completed work joins the grey formed cap runs across several corrugated roof planes.

Project story updated 2026-10-09

A hip-and-ridge intersection is more detailed than a straight cap run. Several roof slopes meet, and the formed metal needs to connect their changing directions. The overall photograph shows the junction in the roof layout. The closer views then identify the intersection, the continuing ridge line and the adjacent corrugated sheets that make up this project.

The completed sequence shows grey capping running along the roof ridge and into the adjoining hip junction. The intersection photograph shows how the formed pieces meet, while another view follows the cap run across the roof. The final close view includes a gloved hand at the finished detail, providing a useful sense of its position and scale.

The intersection needs to work with the capping on both sides, not just look complete from above. The formed shapes, overlaps, visible fixing line and adjoining sheet profile all belong to that connection. This project brings those features into view. It shows the relationship between a detailed junction and the longer roof lines continuing away from it.

The finished photographs show a continuous arrangement of grey hip and ridge capping against the corrugated covering. Owners can compare the wide view with the close junction detail to understand the work. Our metal roof repairs service addresses cap runs, formed intersections, fixings and adjoining sheets, with the required work planned around the actual roof layout.
